hypothesis: Reported comparable revenue growth and parent net margin may supply slow company information without requiring an unavailable direct liabilities total. This is a distinct two-feature family, not a repair or replacement of the existing three-feature snapshot.
source_rules: Inherit the exact revenue concepts, original accession, issuer/USD checks, taxonomy agreement, duration selection, duplicate agreement and prior-period comparability rules in filing_feature_rules.json. Do not alias ProfitLoss, add revenue components or use an archive date as original report end.
balances: No balance amounts used or synthesized. The source payload still undergoes the shared coherence validation; invalid unexcluded facts are not ignored.
denominators: Current and prior comparable total revenue must be strictly positive. Parent net income may be negative.
missingness: Missing or conflicting required flow facts emit no values; never fill from another accession or future filing.
initial_review_scope: All five retained original money payloads: IBM/Kroger early and 2019 annual filings plus fixed Intel missing-liabilities probe. This is not a coverage estimate or stock selection.
next_coverage_gate: Before training, assess full eligible original-filing coverage and causal issuer/price-day availability using predeclared universe/thresholds; preserve failed and missing cases. No checkpoint or stock selection from this source arithmetic.
